spoilers.text: #ONEPIECE1190 BRIEF SPOILERS FOR ONEPIECE CHAPTER 1190 BY ME

spoilers.title: #ONEPIECE1190 GABAN VS. IMU!!! 🔥🔥🔥 ------------------ *Gaban uses a new attack against Imu.* Gaban: "Mantis Axe Style" - "Praying Mantis Plum" !!! *Gaban unleashes a rolling style attack using his
spoilers.text: #ONEPIECE1190 GABAN VS. IMU!!! 🔥🔥🔥 ------------------ *Gaban uses a new attack against Imu.* Gaban: "Mantis Axe Style" - "Praying Mantis Plum" !!! *Gaban unleashes a rolling style attack using his axes against Imu, but Imu blocks it easily by rotating his own axe." Imu: Art thou messing around? Gaban: You want to kill that guy, don't you? Imu: Yes, that's right. Gaban: Is he really that similar...? To Joy Boy...?!!! Imu: Who art thou?! Do you know of Mu? *Imu summons a new sword. He adds Omen to it that shapes like a snake and attacks Gaban with it.* "Honebami Tōshirō"!!! (TL Note: Kanji reads as "骨喰藤四郎" - Honebami Tōshirō. It refers to the legendary Japanese blade Honebami Tōshirō (骨喰藤四郎). It was forged by the master Japanese swordsmith Awataguchi Tōshirō Yoshimitsu during the Kamakura Period. "Honebami" means "Bone-Eater" or "Bone-Devourer." "Honebami Tōshirō" essentially means "Honebami, forged by Tōshirō.") Imu: What dost thou know...?! Gaban: Joy Boy's words. But don't get the wrong idea... we have no intention of following some unknown man from the distant past...!! We only wanted to see our captain's dream through to the very end!! Imu: Cough cough...!! Captain...?! *Luffy is laying on the ground and griping.* Luffy: Ugh!! That damn geezer... making a fool of me...!! Heal!! Heal already!!! Even if it's just this once!!! Imu: Who is thy captain? Gaban: The "Pirate King"... Gol D. Roger!!! *Mini Imu flashback. He's talking to the Five Elders.* Imu: How detestable...!! Why is a "D" called the "Pirate King"?! Do not spread this name. Five Elders: Understood. *Back to the present* Imu: I see... So he's the perpetrator who ushered these seas into the "Age of Piracy". Why does a remnant like you... defend "Straw Hat" Luffy?! Gaban: Because you're deliberately trying to eliminate him!! Doesn't that serve as the greatest proof of all?! That you see him as such a threat?! *mini flashback by Gaban, remembering Roger's words.* Roger: Someone will be born ...and will surpass us!! We were too early. *Back to the present.* Gaban: That kid is... "The Man We've All Been Eagerly Waiting For" !!! *Gaban thinks of Rayleigh, Crocus, Shanks, Oden, Shanks and Whitebeard when he said this line.* (The next panel is Luffy huffing and puffing. LOL) Luffy: Huff... Huff... Imu: Indeed... We were fools. Perchance we have but mistaken countless coincidences for fate. Let us both bring this to an end! *Imu does the 👌 gesture again and aims at Luffy. A sentient Omen flame lands on Luffy's chest." Gaban: Wait, wait, you fool... *Gaban launches in the air and prepares an attack with his two axes.* Gaban: My bad, Treasure Tree Adam...!! I have no intention of eating* you, but...!! (The Japanese word here is "喰らう" (kurau) meaning "to eat" or "to devour", the same Kanji from Gaban's epithet - "山喰らい" (Yamagurai - Mountain Eater) Gaban: Ow, ow, ow, ow...!!! Damn it!! My joints are creaking so badly, this body has turned into a total piece of junk...!! Luffy: That bastard... I won't forgive him, even if he's one of Rayleigh's crewmates...!! Imu: STIG... Gaban: “Kamudo!!!” (Divine Gate)!!! (TL Note: Kanji reads as "神門" litereally meaning "God Gate." A much fitting translation would be "Divine Gate") *Gaban unleashes an Advanced CoC Haki attack from his axes and cuts a big chunk of a branch of the Adam Tree.* Gaban: Huff... Huff... Imu: Even in thy decline, thou art still a crewmate of the Pirate King... Dost thou so dearly wish to believe that?! (Context: Imu is asking Gaban if he truly believes what he said about Luffy) Gaban: That goes for you too, right?! (Context: Gaban is saying that Imu believes it too) *Gaban attacks Imu with an improved version of Yasotakeru (八十梟帥 - 80 Tribal Leaders). Imu uses Honebami.* Gaban: YACHITAKERU!!! (八千梟帥 - 8000 Tribal Leaders) Imu: HONEBAMI!!! (骨喰 - Bone-Eater) *Imu protects himself with a wall of Omen flame emitted from the Xingtian Axe and Honebami Sword. Imu's forehead is bleeding. Large cut up sections of a branch of the Adam Tree falls down to the Underworld.*
